name: io.github.BoxLab-Ltd/yandex-webmaster-mcp
description: Query Yandex Webmaster indexing, queries, diagnostics and backlinks, and recrawl, via an AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WEBMASTER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Default host id, so tools may omit hostId.
